name: Pino Koi
source:
A short visual novel by Morinaga's Pino Ice Cream as part of "Pino-ge Campaign" that people can play by purchasing the the product with Limited Edition package.

"Unlike you, I'm an Ice. So I wanna go home as soon as possible."

The childhood friend and first love Pino appeared in front of the protagonist as a transfer student. Can you melt the cold heart (literally) of Pino, who just won't easily look at you, in 6 days?

[Translated from [url=https://www.itmedia.co.jp/news/articles/2210/18/news168.html]IT Medi[/url]]
